Good to know

Questions,
answered.

Anything else you want to ask? Send it along with your booking.

Do I need to be home during my clean?

Not at all. Many clients share access details and come home to a finished space. If you prefer to be there, that works too.

What do you need before the first visit?

Just a quick description of your space and anything you want us to focus on. We will confirm access and any preferences beforehand.

Do you bring your own supplies?

Yes. We arrive with everything needed. If you would rather we use your products, let us know in the notes.

Is laundry included?

Not in a standard clean. If your home has a washer and dryer, we can wash and fold your clothes as an add-on, for an extra fee.

Do you wash dishes?

Every kitchen surface is wiped and sanitized as standard, but dishes are not part of a basic clean. You can add them for an extra fee when you book.

How far ahead should I book?

Most bookings are placed a few days ahead. Weekend slots often fill first, so earlier is better.

What if something is not right?

Tell us within 24 hours and we will make it right. A final walkthrough helps us catch anything before we leave.
